expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.paristo==='uusi' && S.kennot==='yksi' && S.kytkin==='kiinni' && S.R===2 && S.marks===0 && S.speed===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: uusi paristo, yksi paristo, kytkin kiinni, R = 2,0 Ω, no marked points, speed normaali (must run before any setup)
on load: I = 1,60 V : (2,0 Ω + 0,20 Ω) = 0,727 A (lesson-answers sim-I)
on load: U = 1,60 V - 0,20 Ω · 0,727 A = 1,455 V (lesson-answers sim-U)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===1 && R[0].min==='0.5' && R[0].max==='10' && R[0].step==='0.5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider: load R 0,5–10 Ω in steps of 0,5 Ω

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===4 && L[0]==='uusi,kaytetty' && L[1]==='yksi,sarja,rinnan' && L[2]==='auki,kiinni' && L[3]==='0.4,1,2' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: battery (uusi, käytetty), connection (yksi, sarja, rinnan), switch (auki, kiinni), speed hidas/normaali/nopea

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b.length===2 && b[0]==='Merkitse piste' && b[1]==='Tyhjennä kuvaaja' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Merkitse piste first, then Tyhjennä kuvaaja; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='R,kennot,kytkin,paristo' && P.R.unit==='Ω' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares paristo, kennot, kytkin and R (Ω)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?1040:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas is 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x1040 (stacked panels) when #sim-root is under 500 px

expr: (() => { const t=document.querySelector('#sim-root .readout').textContent; return t.indexOf('Jännitemittari')>=0 && t.indexOf('Virtamittari')>=0 && t.indexOf('Ω')<0 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: the readout shows the meters' U and I only, not E or R_s (the student finds them from the graph)
